name: Varicosa District
desc:
The Varicosa District is a section of The City of the Drowned distinguished by bright paths and buildings with red roofs.

[Jeremiah](entity:jeremiah), an NPC that you can trade Deep Gems to for items, can be found here.
additional_info: -   Due to the Varicosan Finery Outfit and the location flavour text, it can be assumed that this was the home to the upper class of Celtor.
